notes.title: (Ver.2.03.02)
notes.content:
👻 Hello, it's been a while since the last update.
Based on your feedback and observations from streams, I've made improvements to enhance the gameplay experience.

● I noticed some players were getting stuck on puzzles, so I've added special hints to the shop. Now, the gift box won't be as scary! 🎁
● Items in the shop were being purchased with just a tap, so I've updated the process to tap-to-select, then press the purchase button—now it's back to the standard procedure.
● Reduced the cost of the ghost aura gauge from 200 coins to 100 coins.
● Revised some hint icons for better clarity.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/40581767/b245cea6e3bcc49787fb41004186a9791fe31d39.jpg[/img]

If you notice anything else, feel free to reach out!

🌱 The third installment of the series is [No Ghost in Circus Caravan]!
It's currently in the preview stage. I hope you're excited for it!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2733820/_/

notes.title: (Ver. 2.02.05) Game balance adjustment, addition of progression assist display
notes.content:
👻Hello, it's been a while since our last update!

● I've added Japanese menu support.
● Improved the clarity of the 'Click photo to buy hints' feature as it was a bit hard to understand.

That's all for now.
For those who've already completed the game, why not spend some time on duty with Anna again?

🌱 Second installment in the series, 'Sky Elevator', is also available now and receiving great reviews!
Thank you for your support! 🤗
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2412050/_/

notes.title: (Ver. 2.02.05) Game balance adjustment, addition of progression assist display
notes.content:
👻 Hello everyone! 🎃
This is our first update in 6 months.

We have reworked the game balance and greatly eased the need for a large amount of coins for no reason.
We also adjusted the balance regarding achievements.

Also, the in-game store is now highlighted under certain conditions.
It is now easier to notice items required for additional content and some endings, reducing the element of confusion.

So, please continue to enjoy the mysterious stay home!


🌱The newest addition to the series [No Ghost in Sky Elevator] is also now on sale!
We are also planning to produce a third installment in 2024.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2412050/_/

notes.title: (Ver. 2.02.04) Fix problem of not being able to play
notes.content:
Thanks for your time! 👻🎃
I have been receiving reports that the game has been "unplayable" since the update on the 12th.
My apologies!

Upon investigation, it turned out that there was a problem with the build method I had been using in the production tool ClickteamFusion, and I have changed the build method.
Please update your software so that you can play again.

🌱The latest version is Ver. 2.02.04.
The bug that caused jumpscares not to load and progress to be disabled in some endings has also been resolved.
Almost all known problems have been resolved, and the hint icons have been adjusted to a level of difficulty clarity that seems appropriate.

If there are no further problems, this will be the final version. Enjoy!
If there are still bugs, please report them to us and we will fix them.

🌱For horror games, we will focus on new releases in the future.
Starting next year, we plan to release one horror game every year around [b]early summer. [/b]
We look forward to working with you in the future!

notes.title: (Ver. 2.02.01) Bug fixes and adjustments
notes.content:
👻Thanks for your time!🎃
Glad you continue to play with us.
Bug fixes and a few other updates for the Halloween update.

Sound is now played even when inactive.
Relaxed some end conditions.
Fixed some hints to make them easier to understand.
The following bugs have been fixed
 -When some endings are reached, jumpscares are not loaded and the game does not progress.
 --The cause cannot be determined, so the game will continue to progress even if the jumpscares are not loaded.
 -Multiple endings could be achieved in the Halloween room at the same time.
 -Only the sound of a window breaking is heard
 -Bats' shadows are hard to recognize
 -Anna's facial expression reverts back to during the event when in high ghost aura

We're preparing to produce a new horror game and a click game, so we hope you'll look forward to them!
([The Travel Game] also please visit us 🤗 https://store.steampowered.com/app/2123800/_/)

notes.title: Steam Scream Fest update (Ver.2.01.03)
notes.content:
Long time no see!
👻✨🎃Happy Halloween! 🎃✨👻
I'm happy to announce that [No Ghost is Stay Home] has been invited to the Steam Scream Fest (Halloween event)!

Thanks to all the people who bought the game and talked about it on the game's live stream, articles, etc.
Thank you so much.

[h3]Corresponding update[/h3].
👻Major updates to support the Halloween event.
...Ana's Room (Halloween) has been implemented.
　It can be purchased from the SHOP.
　(It is not DLC or a chargeable element, and coins can be obtained in-game.)
The events that occur in the Halloween room and 10 different endings have been added.
　*Only English/Japanese are supported.
The item "Ghost Aura Gauge" has been added. It makes it easier to see the ups and downs of the Ghost Aura.
　It can be turned on/off after purchase.

[h3]Other updates[/h3].
Tips added.
Some of the hint icons have been changed to be easier to understand.
(TV screen) Increased the appearance rate of Almy.
Removed the effect that the disability is reduced to 0 when Almy appears.
Fixed a bug that Ana's animation did not play when the exorcist appeared.
Minor bug fixes and adjustments.

That's all. If you notice anything, we would appreciate it if you could give us feedback via bulletin board, e-mail, Twitter DM, etc.
Have a great Halloween!

notes.title: Several bug fixes + translation improvements
notes.content:
Thanks for your help 👻!

We've fixed all the bugs we've had feedback and discovered so far.
We have also improved the translation (Korean, German, Spanish).

[Bug Fixes]
When the exorcist appeared, Ana sometimes did not change.
The game behavior became strange when opening the hole in the wall just before the time change.
There was an ending where Steam achievements were not unlocked.

This game has been Let's played (Distribution of game playing) by people from many different countries.
I'm very happy and grateful for that.
There are no restrictions on the production of Let's play, videos, or derivative of Midori Games' works.
I'm a big fan of live game play, and I support it =)


If you have any questions, please feel free to contact me via the community forums, email, or Twitter DM.
Take care of yourself!

notes.title: 2 important fixes
notes.content:
Thank you very much for your feedback👻
We've fixed two bugs that were interfering with the progress of the game based on the information you provided.

-It was possible to move from one screen to another during the coin tally (and then the operation became impossible).
-Cocoon or the man in the cage would sometimes turn into a mutated potted plant.

Please continue to let us know if you notice anything on the community board, email, or Twitter DM.
Please stay healthy!
